Nina (partnerships): Heads-up: vendor call later today. Focus: harmonize announce windows across cloud marketplaces, confirm per-region thermal mitigations for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi, and decide a fallback routing plan for hot racks. Need a short status.

Omar (hw-ops): Lab spot-check: H200 BIOS v2.4 helps but some racks still spike under sustained 4h runs. APAC racks (DC-C) need adjusted fan curves. Quick table:
H100 peak 640W / sustained 510W; H200 peak 710W / sustained 600W; MI300 peak 690W / sustained 570W; Gaudi peak 410W / sustained 350W.

Priya (marketplace): Marketplace constraint: final image tags + SKU metadata 72h before soft announce. We can publish SKUs as hidden and flip visibility at go-live if a region slips. Need health-check path to wire canaries.

Ethan (platform): Suggest rollout: NA -> EU -> APAC with 24h canaries. Add routing rule: if GPU power >92% for 2m OR temp >80C for 90s, route to q4_k8 variant and page oncall. I'll open PR with flags.

Omar (hw-ops): Will validate thresholds in lab-rt-25 and upload logs. Also documenting BIOS rollback steps in case of regressions.

Nina (partnerships): Actions: (1) Omar finalize BIOS cutoff + rollback doc, (2) Priya stage hidden SKUs and health URLs, (3) Ethan implement gating + fallback PR, (4) Partnerships draft embargo language and coordinate legal. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.
